scene: The brass hatch opens downward, dumping you into a bustling transit junction.
picture: A flat side view along a polished tile groundline. The girl stands left of centre, upright again, sketchbook underarm. At far left sits a whirring clockwork carousel train on brass tracks. In the centre, an open glass pneumatic capsule waits in a pipe. At far right floats an iridescent bubble lift.
shown: a mechanical carousel train with brass animal cars idling on rails at far left
a clear glass capsule pod parked inside a vertical suction pipe in the centre
an enormous shimmering soap-bubble elevator hovering over a floor grate at far right
